run_wasm_torture_tests: run wasm torture tests from ./emwasm-torture-out/*.wasm using the Subzero code generator
run_wasm_torture_tests_verbose: run wasm torture tests with verbose output to see detailed compilation and execution logs
run_wasm_torture_tests_translate_only: run wasm torture tests in translate-only mode to compile without linking or executing
run_wasm_torture_tests_specific: run wasm torture tests on specific .wasm test files passed as command-line arguments
run_wasm_torture_tests_parallel: run wasm torture tests in parallel using threads across all CPU cores
